notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
braa performs rapid bulk OID enumeration across SNMP targets using a validated community string. Faster than snmpwalk for large OID trees because it sends many requests in parallel rather than walking sequentially.

=== CHAINING ===
1. Discover SNMP service with nmap -sU -p 161 2. Brute community string with onesixtyone 3. Bulk enumerate OIDs with braa using validated string → correlate contact/hostname with DNS findings.

=== WHAT IT REVEALS ===
OS version/kernel, system contact email, hostname, location string, uptime, running processes, installed packages with versions. Package list enables targeted CVE lookups without a vulnerability scanner.

=== DETECTION ===
Bulk SNMP queries generate high volumes of UDP packets to port 161. SNMPv3 with auth would block this entirely. Network monitoring comparing SNMP query volume to baseline will flag anomalies.
